<job>
Title: Appointment Setter For Marketing Agency
Job Overview: We are seeking a highly motivated and organized Appointment Setter to join our sales team. As an Appointment Setter, you will be responsible for contacting leads via direct messages (DMs) and phone calls to schedule appointments for our sales team to conduct sales calls with potential clients. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, be able to work in a fast-paced environment, and have a positive attitude. Key Responsibilities: -Conduct outreach to potential clients via direct messages (DMs) and phone calls to schedule appointments for our sales team. -Use various communication techniques to persuade potential clients to schedule appointments with our sales team. -Record all interactions with potential clients accurately and efficiently in our CRM system. -Follow up with potential clients to ensure they have received and read our communications. -Work with the sales team to ensure that appointments are scheduled efficiently and effectively. Requirements: -1-2 years of experience in appointment setting or telemarketing. -Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. -Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. -Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks at once. -Positive attitude and strong work ethic. -Proficient in using CRM tools. -Familiarity with sales techniques and best practices.
</job>

text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience working with data analysis, Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Power BI, dashboard building, data cleaning, and data visualization, and I’d be glad to bring that same organized, detail-focused approach to your appointment setting team.

While my background is in data work rather than appointment setting, I’m very comfortable with fast-paced, process-driven work that depends on clear communication, accuracy, and follow-through. I understand the importance of reaching out to leads professionally, keeping records organized in a CRM, following up consistently, and making sure every interaction is tracked correctly so the sales team can move quickly and efficiently.

One project that reflects this mindset was a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture in retail. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. The result was that 14 reports were consolidated into 1, and monthly close reporting went from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required careful data handling, strong organization, and a focus on making information easy to act on—skills that translate well to managing outreach workflows, maintaining clean CRM records, and staying on top of follow-ups.

I’m comfortable working with structured processes, handling multiple tasks, and keeping details accurate. I also bring a positive, professional attitude and I’m used to working with tools and systems where precision matters. If you need someone who can stay organized, communicate clearly, and help keep your appointment pipeline moving efficiently, I’d be happy to support your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
